title: Yeasty Japanese Sausages Mochi
description: Delicious Japanese-inspired sausages wrapped in soft, chewy mochi, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning. A vegetarian-friendly twist on traditional Japanese cuisine.

ingredients.name: Kabanos Sausages
ingredients.notes: Any vegetarian Japanese-style sausage alternatives can be used.

instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups of sushi-grade mochi rice with 1/2 cup of water and stir gently until the dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Wrap each kabanos sausage in a piece of the mochi dough, shaping it into a cylindrical shape.
Place the wrapped sausages in a copper pot with a small amount of water and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, or until the mochi is heated through.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
